mentions.name: Fancy Hacker News
mentions.description: A Firefox browser extension that enhances the Hacker News experience, improving mobile support and adding a dark mode. Currently has only 2 Firefox users, including the author.
mentions.problem: Hacker News' desktop experience is fine, but mobile support is poor and dark mode is lacking; existing alternatives are abandoned (Modern for Hacker News) or Android-only (Harmonic).
mentions.audience: Personal use — built to scratch the author's own itch
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on (yet another) Hacker News browser extension, mostly to scratch my own itch. The desktop experience on HN is fine, but I don't love mobile support or lack of dark mode.

evidence.value: I'm working on (yet another) Hacker News browser extension, mostly to scratch my own itch. The desktop experience on HN is fine, but I don't love mobile support or lack of dark mode.
